digest.component_or_area: core reconciler dispatch and transport capability detection
propositions: Four capability call sites in the reconciler use static type casts without runtime guards, allowing AttributeError to be silently swallowed when the transport lacks an opt-in capability.
A transport missing an optional capability (add_comment or set_relationship) causes the mutation to not be applied, but the pass still reports success, conflating designed skips with real failures.
Runtime guards using isinstance against @runtime_checkable Protocols must precede capability member calls to distinguish absent capabilities from actual exceptions.

Capability-absent events must be logged distinctly through the existing bridge_alerts channel with specific alert kinds (outbound-comment-capability-absent, outbound-link-capability-absent) and counted as computed but not applied.
The isinstance guard requires a hasattr fallback because Python 3.12+ getattr_static does not detect __getattr__ proxied attributes, making decorator/wrapper transports incorrectly appear incapable.
_call_with_retry must relocate from dispatch_one.py to dispatch_apply_phases.py to stay within the 800-LOC module-size constraint after adding capability guards.
